race.comment: DIVINE JUSTICE (6) followed up his eye-catching finish at the Gold Coast with a dominant win at the Sunny Coast when justifying favouritism. Full of confidence with fitness on his side, he keeps Benny Thompson piloting and can repeat the dose. ED I AM (7) has returned in good order this prep and will find this a bit easier after a midfield finish in town at the latest. Philpot's 2kg claim helps and he's right in the mix over a trip he relishes. SUZE SPRITZ (4) was brave when wide throughout and beaten just 0.6L at the Gold Coast. Her form is patchy but her best is up to scratch. CANTANKEROUS (5) has patchy form but but has the peaks to measure up and was a winner over this track and trip three back. A soft draw also helps.
